landing.prepare_documents_without_losing: Prepare documents without losing the evidence.
landing.understand_the_path_from_a_raw_s: Understand the path from a raw source to an inspectable prepared revision. Read the principles, then follow the same lifecycle in a local workbench.
landing.two_independent_views_produce_on: Two independent views produce one canonical working document.
landing.raw_documents_are_not_yet_trustw: Raw documents are not yet trustworthy corpus material.
landing.extraction_creates_a_useful_repr: Extraction creates a useful representation, but it can also expose layout noise, structural traps, and ambiguous text. Preparation makes those conditions visible before downstream systems inherit them.
landing.compare_independent_views_and_ke: Compare independent views and keep the original source identity attached.
landing.record_concrete_findings_and_aff: Record concrete findings and affected document items before proposing a change.
landing.keep_diagnosis_separate_from_the: Keep diagnosis separate from the human decision to approve or reject a refinement.
landing.ways_to_learn_the_same_core: ways to learn the same core
landing.the_project_exposes_sources_extr: The project exposes sources, extraction views, findings, decisions, revisions, and corpus reports instead of hiding them behind one result.
landing.the_guides_workbench_and_cli_tea: The guides, Workbench, and CLI teach the same project-owned lifecycle rather than separate demo paths.
landing.diagnosis_can_identify_a_conditi: Diagnosis can identify a condition, but only a recorded approve or reject decision resolves a proposal.
landing.each_approved_change_creates_a_n: Each approved change creates a new prepared revision and preserves the evidence behind it.
landing.evidence_identifies_a_condition_: Evidence identifies a condition. You decide whether the document changes.
landing.read_the_principles_practice_the: Read the principles. Practice the path. Inspect every record.
landing.each_interface_serves_a_differen: Each interface serves a different learning need while using the same document lifecycle.
landing.learn_why_each_preparation_step_: Learn why each preparation step exists and what evidence it produces.
landing.explore_guided_documents_through: Explore guided documents through Observe, Diagnose, Refine, and Revision.
landing.run_the_complete_lifecycle_and_v: Run the complete lifecycle and verify the records yourself.
landing.a_finding_becomes_understandable: A finding becomes understandable when you can follow its change.
landing.the_guided_whitespace_example_co: The guided whitespace example connects one diagnosis rule, one supported refiner, one explicit decision, and one immutable revision.
landing.the_finding_identifies_the_exact: The finding identifies the exact affected content. R001 proposes only the supported mechanical change.
landing.make_the_lifecycle_visible_befor: Make the lifecycle visible before asking the learner to move forward.
landing.start_from_a_guided_fixture_or_a: Start from a guided fixture or a supported local document. Inspect extraction, run diagnosis, review one supported proposal, record a decision, and follow the prepared revision without editing JSON.
landing.observe_compare_two_extraction_v: Observe: compare two extraction views and inspect the canonical working document before diagnosis.
landing.observe_diagnose_refine_and_revi: Observe, Diagnose, Refine, and Revision each answer one learner question.
landing.summary_evidence_and_artifacts_s: Summary, Evidence, and Artifacts stay scoped to the current stage and round.
landing.before_and_after_comparisons_mak: Before-and-after comparisons make approve and reject choices concrete.
landing.keep_evidence_inspectable_and_pe: Keep evidence inspectable and people in control.
landing.the_project_treats_evidence_and_: The project treats evidence and authority as different things. That distinction stays visible in the records and the interfaces.
landing.preserve_the_record_behind_every: Preserve the record behind every result.
landing.original_sources_extraction_arti: Original sources, extraction artifacts, findings, proposals, decisions, transformations, hashes, and revisions remain available for inspection.
landing.a_finding_does_not_approve_a_cha: A finding does not approve a change.
landing.diagnosis_identifies_a_condition: Diagnosis identifies a condition. A supported proposal changes the document only after an explicit human decision.
landing.the_workbench_does_not_hide_the_: The workbench does not hide the preparation path behind one final document. Each stage leaves a focused record that can be read and verified.
landing.run_the_same_mechanics_command_b: Run the same mechanics command by command.
landing.the_cli_is_the_complete_compact_: The CLI is the complete, compact interface for learners who want to repeat a lifecycle, inspect raw output, or verify published records directly.
landing.chunking_embeddings_indexing_ret: Chunking, embeddings, indexing, retrieval, generation, and RAG evaluation remain downstream. This project stays focused on making document preparation understandable and inspectable.
meta.description: Learn document preparation through an inspectable lifecycle, a local Workbench, and a direct CLI.
